negativeResult.collection: Massachusetts Bay colony military & court records (MBCR vols 1-5) and the Military Company (Ancient and Honorable Artillery) membership roll
limitations: Only the two routine colony-level Gurney entries (1641 powder-fine remission; 1644 Jenner-bill acceptance) were found.
Printed colony records and FTS-indexed films were swept; manuscript town training-band muster rolls survive poorly and were not separately examined.
The Ancient and Honorable Artillery Company was a Boston company; absence there does not preclude ordinary Weymouth training-band membership, for which no roll survives.

statement: No record places John Gurney in active military service: the 1641 powder fine reflects only the ordinary readiness obligation, and a Gurn-variant sweep of the colony military/court records plus a full read of the printed colony records and the Military Company roll (1637-1652) finds him on no campaign, officer, volunteer, or membership list.
